data.name: Project: Idol / Empire
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

🌐 When the online world is a warzone, and being "UwU" is your deadliest weapon.

Welcome to a totally fucked-up near future, where neon lights hide the rot and everyone is addicted to their screens... In this world, "Views" are God, and "Clout" is your golden ticket to everything.

Play as Lumina, the Queen V-Tuber currently hyping up the network. On-camera, her image is a bright, innocent, cutesy idol... But let me tell you, all of that is total "Cap" (BS)!

Project: Idol / Empire isn't some sunshine-and-rainbows idol raising sim, just so you know. It’s a mind-bending Cyberpunk Thriller / Management game. It mashes up base-defense Action with world domination strategy and a super dark story. You get to play the "Ultimate Villain Queen" using a streamer persona as a front. The real goal? Hack this entire damn city and hold it in the palm of your hand!

🎭 The Double Life (Two-Faced as Hell)

  • On-Cam (The Idol): Roleplay as sweet "Lil' Lumina." Livestream, crack jokes, do fan service, and keep that "internet's darling" image absolutely flawless to farm views and siphon as many donations as possible!

  • Off-Cam (The Mastermind): Stream off, mask off! You are the genius hacker behind "Project: Masquerade." Plan how to use your idol money to upgrade systems, breach databases, and silently spread your dark influence to take over the network.

🎮 Key Features (Don't Miss These)

📡 Live Stream Defense: I Run This Stream!

The livestream screen is your battlefield. While you're busy with fan service on cam, you gotta prepare to deal with real-time cyberattacks!

  • Action-Paced Gameplay: Use Hacking skills to slap down Spam Bots, wipe out viruses, and block troll hackers trying to crash your stream.

  • Risk Management: Manage your Energy and skill cooldowns perfectly. One slip-up, and the "mask" you built might fall off mid-stream!

🗺️ World Domination Strategy: Stream's Over, Time for Real Business.

The real war starts when you go offline. Use the "Network Map" to plan long-term cyber world domination.

  • Claim Turf, Control Zones: Open the network map and personally hack and seize key Nodes across the entire map! Expand your dark influence and farm new resources to strengthen your army.

  • Upgrade Attack Commands: Use donation money to upgrade brutal Hacking skills to counter hackers, slap Spam Bots, and completely eradicate viruses.

🖥️ The Dark Room Narrative: Dark Stories Behind the Mic.

Dive into a detail-rich Cyberpunk-style room. Consume intense lore delivered through Visual Novel storytelling.

  • Information is Power: Snoop on encrypted emails, lurk on social media drama, and dig up hidden Lore to understand your enemies and this world.

  • High-Pressure Choices: Got a blackmail email, now what? Every decision you make today might affect how hard tomorrow's stream will be.

🎨 Cyberpunk Aesthetics: Stunning Visuals & Vibes.

  • Distinctive 2D Anime Style: Perfectly blends the bright cutesy idol aesthetic with intense neon lights and a dark dystopian atmosphere.

  • Sleek UI: An interface designed to make you feel like you're actually sitting in command behind a futuristic computer screen.

Are you ready to wear the mask and build an empire on lies?

data.short_description: Behind the cheerful "Internet's Darling" persona is a ruthless hacker mastermind! In Project: Idol / Empire, balance a double life: be an adored idol while waging cyberwar for world domination. Defend your streams, plan network takeovers, and build an empire under a mask that fools the whole server!
data.supported_languages: English, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Thai, Korean

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows xp or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core2Duo or higher/ AMD Athlon 64 or higher
  • Graphics: DirectX 9 higher
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
